instructions.value: In the view condition, participants were instructed not to regulate their emotions, but to attend to and rate the faces. For increasing their emotional experience, they were instructed to imagine that the face belonged to a close person, such as a sibling or friend, who was really angry at them because they had done something wrong. For decreasing their emotional experience, they were instructed to imagine that the face belonged to a stranger who might actually be a nice person but was having a bad day. Participants rated their emotional state from 1 (very uncomfortable) to 8 (very comfortable).
